name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reroute.multipass_subtree_hop
title: Open: the per-threshold hop of the multi-pass positional masked GGH15 walk (ERASE plus the two-pass reroute)
statement: Positional masked gamma-tensor GGH15 (Def_WE_MaskedGGH15.positionalView) over h levels whose first c*n levels are c >= 2 copies of n witness bits, for a CNF Psi containing the equality clauses between consecutive copies. If rows^(2(2c-1)) >= 2^n (rows = 3 dR + w n' + n), t < 2^n, and no string whose first copy is the Gray codeword of rank t (as the first n bits of grayCode h (t 2^(h-n))) satisfies Psi, then under decision LWE with k bits in the CVW18 regime, hybrids t 2^(h-n) and (t+1) 2^(h-n) are CloseAt with loss (h+1) hopLoss(h, rows) and simulation cost simCost.
